t: This behaves like the $(l:modules/puller_1)Puller Mk1/$, but can pull items from non-adjacent inventories.$(p)The inventory can be up to 12 blocks away (up to 24 with $(l:augments/range_up)Range Augments/$); clear line of sight is $(italic)not/$ required.
这个模块的行为类似于$(l:modules/puller_1)抽取模块 Mk1/$，但它可以从不相邻的容器中拉取物品。$(p)目标容器最远可在 12 格外（配合$(l:augments/range_up)范围升级拓展/$时可达 24 格）；并且$(italic)不/$需要视线畅通。

$(li)To select the target inventory, $(thing)Sneak-Right-click/$ the block with the Puller Mk2 module in hand. You will get a confirmation message.$(li)While holding a Puller Mk2 with a target set, the targeted block will be highlighted.
$(li)要选择目标容器，请手持抽取模块 Mk2 对方块$(thing)潜行右键单击/$。你会收到一条确认消息。$(li)手持已设定目标的抽取模块 Mk2 时，目标方块会被高亮显示。
